instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: LegalTech startup providing an AI-powered contract lifecycle management platform for SME legal departments. Automating contract review, clause extraction, obligation tracking, and renewal management. We are expanding into regulatory change monitoring with automated contract impact analysis to remain relevant.
answers.pastInitiatives: We experimented with a customer self-service portal two years ago after seeing competitors offer similar functionality. We built an MVP with an external agency in 3 months, but customer adoption was disappointing—only 8% of customers created accounts. This failure highlighted that our initial product focus did not align with user pain points or market need.
answers.strategicGoals: Our industry is facing structural decline due to technological disruption and changing consumer behavior in transactional law. We cannot rely on incremental improvements to our legacy business; we need to identify entirely new value propositions that leverage our brand, customer relationships, or operational capabilities in adjacent spaces where demand is growing.
answers.additionalContext: Synapse is currently focused on optimizing its core contract management solution but recognizes that long-term survival requires finding non-legal adjacent markets. The founder is willing to take calculated risks, prioritizing market capture over short-term stability.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.

opportunities.title: Hyper-automation of Core Workflow Modules
opportunities.rationale: Focus on improving existing contract review speed and accuracy using LLMs for more complex clause extraction (e.g., indemnity clauses). This leverages current technical assets to increase product stickiness and reduce operational costs.

first_actions: Pilot a new machine learning model specifically for identifying high-risk liability clauses.
Allocate 50% of developer cycle time next quarter exclusively to refining the extraction logic.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce average contract review processing time by 15% within two quarters.
milestones: Q1: Model prototype completed and tested on 100 sample contracts
Q2: Integration of the improved model into beta product for pilot customers

opportunities.title: Diversification: Compliance Consulting as a Service (CaaS)
opportunities.rationale: Given the medium regulatory environment, diversify into offering high-touch compliance advisory services using Synapse's contract data. This moves the company from a software vendor to a strategic partner, leveraging proprietary market intelligence.

first_actions: Identify 3 niche industry verticals (e.g., FinTech or Healthcare SME).
Develop a minimum viable compliance reporting dashboard based on contract data insights.
resources_needed: Investment in specialized regulatory database subscriptions
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 5 retainer clients for CaaS services within the first year.
milestones: Q1: Define CaaS service catalog and pricing structure
Q3: Launch pilot program with initial niche clients

next_steps.action: Conduct a detailed market scan for three non-legal adjacent service lines (e.g., Regulatory Tech/Compliance) and prioritize the most viable entry point.

Establish an informal 'Innovation Sandbox' dedicated to radical diversification projects, allocating a mandatory minimum of 5% of developer time per quarter for exploratory work outside the core product.
Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and success metrics for both the incremental automation project and the radical diversification entry point to ensure budget alignment.

key_weaknesses: Informal innovation process leading to inconsistent prioritization and execution gaps.
Lack of dedicated R&D talent, placing the burden on generalist developers during high-pressure operational cycles.
Low digital maturity (Level 1), making scalable customer acquisition and self-service difficult.
Over-reliance on owner decision-making, which risks tunnel vision and ignores necessary cross-functional expertise.
